_note: Shared AudioTrack for every KURIO ad (A–D). null = silent (v4). When a commercially licensed track is approved, put it in public/audio/ and set src to its public path, e.g. "audio/kurio-track.mp3". The same track then goes into all four ads: Studio previews it, and tools/render-ad.mjs muxes it under the final 15 s video (video stream copied, not re-encoded).
